# Conformance Vectors

Signed bundles, each with the verdict every consumer must reach: mediatore, mediatore-guest and the gateway test against these files, which notaio's own verifier passes in CI. They live in `crates/sandboxpolicy-bundle/conformance/` (`vectors.json`, and `bundle-v3.schema.json`, the payload's JSON Schema) and in `sandboxpolicy_bundle::conformance`. How to use them is in [Consume a Bundle](../guides/consume-a-bundle.md).

Bundle schema `sandbox.firestoned.io/bundle/v3`. Trusted key, for these vectors only: `conformance:v1`. Every vector concerns the policy `conformance/agent`; its floor is the consumer's floor for that policy before the envelope.

| Vector | Floor before | Verdict | What it checks |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accepted-first-sight` | none | accepted, v3 | No floor yet: a valid bundle is accepted and becomes the floor. |
| `accepted-same-version` | v3 of `0001` | accepted, v3 | The floor's own version again: accepted, the floor unchanged. |
| `accepted-newer-version` | v2 of `0001` | accepted, v3 | A higher version of the same incarnation: accepted, the floor moves up. |
| `accepted-new-incarnation` | v9 of `0002` | accepted, v3 | A recreated policy (new uid) issued after the floor's bundle: accepted, the floor moves to it. |
| `refused-downgrade` | v4 of `0001` | refused: `Downgrade` | A lower version of the incarnation the floor holds: refused. |
| `refused-stale-incarnation` | v1 of `0002` | refused: `StaleIncarnation` | Another incarnation, issued no later than the floor's bundle: a replay from before a recreation, refused. |
| `refused-forged-signature` | none | refused: `NoValidSignature` | One bit of the signature flipped: refused. |
| `refused-untrusted-key` | none | refused: `NoValidSignature` | Signed by a key nobody trusts, under the trusted key's id: refused. |
| `refused-expired` | none | refused: `Expired` | The consumer's clock at notAfter exactly: refused. |
| `refused-not-yet-valid` | none | refused: `NotYetValid` | Issued five minutes after the consumer's clock, beyond the 60 seconds of skew: refused. |
| `refused-digest-mismatch` | none | refused: `DigestMismatch` | Validly signed, but contentDigest is not the digest of the content: refused. |
| `refused-old-schema` | none | refused: `Schema` | Validly signed, but schema v2: refused, never read as v3. |
| `refused-payload-type` | none | refused: `PayloadType` | The envelope's payload type is v2: refused before anything else is read. |
| `refused-malformed` | none | refused: `Malformed` | The payload is not base64: refused. |
